Junior Data Analyst – Bucharest

Join the Market Vector Team!

Who We Are

Market Vector is a leading international market research agency with a presence across 8 countries in Central & Eastern Europe and the USA, offering a wide range of data solutions to help clients gain deeper market insights and make informed strategic decisions.

We specialize in data analytics, providing detailed reports on market trends, market share, distribution, and pricing.

What We Are Looking For

We are seeking an enthusiastic and dedicated Junior Data Analyst who is eager to grow professionally and join our dynamic team.

Requirements

·        University degree in a relevant field (Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Engineering) - mandatory.

·        Advanced knowledge of Excel (tables, advanced formulas, pivot tables).

·        Experience with Power Query, Power BI, SQL, Python, or other analytical tools is a plus.

·        Analytical mindset and comfort working with large sets of numbers.

·        Strong attention to detail, good organizational skills, punctuality.

·        Stable residence in Bucharest.

Responsibilities

·       Data extraction and integration: Pulling data from various internal and external databases and spreadsheets to support team projects.

·        Data cleaning: Identifying and fixing errors, duplicates, or missing information to ensure high data quality for analysis.

·        Data analysis: Analyzing datasets to identify trends, inconsistencies, and patterns

·        Data reporting and visualization - Designing clear charts and interactive dashboards to make complex data easy for the team to understand.

·        Collaborating with the team to resolve data-related issues.

 

Salary Package & Benefits

Competitive monthly net salary.

Meal vouchers.

Private medical insurance.

Continuous professional development opportunities.

 

The chance to work in a high-performing team within a growing international company.

 

We look forward to meeting you.
